requirements.quote: Bump the version field in /home/user/projects/website/package.json from 1.2.3 to 1.3.0 (a MINOR bump).
The new section must appear ABOVE every older section.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import sys
l = open("/home/user/projects/website/CHANGELOG.md").read().splitlines()
sys.exit(0 if l[:4] == ["## [1.3.0] - 2024-06-01", "### Added", "- Implemented blog post search feature.", ""] else 1)'

requirements.quote: Create a new release log file at
with **one single line** (no extra blank lines, include the trailing period in the message):

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import sys
c = open("/home/user/projects/website/release.log").read()
lines = c.splitlines()
sys.exit(0 if len(lines) == 1 and lines[0].rstrip(".") == "2024-06-01 1.3.0 Minor release published" and not c.endswith("\n\n") else 1)'
